/* ── accordion header ─────────────────────────────────────── */

/* ── materials block (top of each panel) ──────────────────── */
.res-rows {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr;
  gap: .45rem 1.1rem;
  align-items: baseline;
  font-size: .875rem;
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
}
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .res-rows { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: .1rem; }

}

.res-label {
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.res-val { line-height: 1.65; }
.res-val a { text-decoration: none; }
.res-val a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* the thing they have to hand in */

.res-sub { opacity: .6; font-size: .82rem; }
.res-sep { opacity: .3; margin: 0 .45rem; }

/* ── two-column objectives ────────────────────────────────── */
.slo-cols {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0 2.5rem;
}
@media (max-width: 760px) { .slo-cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

.slo-list { list-style: none; padding-left: 0; margin-bottom: 0; }
.slo-list li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1.15rem;
  margin-bottom: .45rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ── Bloom dots ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.bloom-dot {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: .5em;
  width: .58rem;
  height: .58rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  cursor: help;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,0);
  transition: box-shadow .15s;
}
.bloom-dot:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(128,128,128,.25); }

/* ── break row ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.accordion-button.break-week {
  background-color: var(--bs-secondary-bg);
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);

<script>
(function () {
  const weeks = {
    w00: ['2026-08-31', '2026-09-05'],
    w01: ['2026-09-07', '2026-09-12'],
    w02: ['2026-09-14', '2026-09-19'],
    w03: ['2026-09-21', '2026-09-26'],
    w04: ['2026-09-28', '2026-10-03'],
    w05: ['2026-10-05', '2026-10-10'],
    w06: ['2026-10-12', '2026-10-15'],
    w07: ['2026-10-16', '2026-10-22'], // Fall Break — no expand
    w08: ['2026-10-23', '2026-10-31'],
    w09: ['2026-11-02', '2026-11-07'],
    w10: ['2026-11-09', '2026-11-14'],
    w11: ['2026-11-16', '2026-11-21'],
    w12: ['2026-11-23', '2026-11-28'],
    w13: ['2026-11-30', '2026-12-05'],
    w14: ['2026-12-07', '2026-12-09'],
  };

  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  for (const [id, [start, end]] of Object.entries(weeks)) {
    const s = new Date(start), e = new Date(end);
    e.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    if (today < s || today > e) continue;

    // Highlight the button
    const btn = document.querySelector(`[data-bs-target="#${id}"]`);
    if (!btn) break;
    btn.classList.add('current-week');

    // Add badge
    const badge = document.createElement('span');
    badge.className = 'current-week-badge';
    badge.textContent = '📍 Current week';
    btn.appendChild(badge);

    // Auto-expand (skip Fall Break)
    if (id === 'w07') break;
    const panel = document.getElementById(id);
    if (panel) {
      panel.classList.add('show');
      btn.classList.remove('collapsed');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    }
    break;
  }
})();
</script>
